summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of traeningsmester.dk Vite/React landing page. Verified hero rendering, all section scroll-reveal, sticky pillar active state, FAQ accordion, 4 footer legal modals (open/close via X, Escape, backdrop), cookie banner + persistence, header scrolled state, header CTA + nav anchor links, mobile hamburger drawer, footer waitlist form presence, and live Supabase waitlist submit. Hero waitlist invalid-email and missing-consent validations both produce the correct Danish error messages. Happy-path submit (consent checked) returned HTTP 201 from supabase rest endpoint and showed 'Tak — du er skrevet op. Vi siger til.' success state. Performed only ONE real Supabase POST as instructed.

issues: Document has ~12px of horizontal overflow on mobile (documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth = 12). Likely the marquee/decoration leaks past safe area; minor — no visible horizontal scrollbar to user but worth a tighter overflow-x: hidden on body/main.

csp_console_warnings: Browser logs 'Content Security Policy directive frame-ancestors is ignored when delivered via a <meta> element' — this directive only works as an HTTP header. Cosmetic console noise, no functional impact, but in index.html the frame-ancestors part of the CSP meta should be removed (and moved to a real header via vercel.json/server config) to silence the warning.

Cloudflare insights beacon ('https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/...') is blocked by the strict script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' CSP. The beacon is injected by the Emergent preview proxy / Cloudflare in front of the site, not by the app itself, so the block is actually desirable (site doesn't want third-party scripts). Mention only — no action needed for the redesign.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): remove 'frame-ancestors' from the index.html CSP <meta> tag (browsers ignore it there) and instead set it as an HTTP header in vercel.json / hosting config — clears the 6 repeated console errors.
OPTIONAL: fix ~12px horizontal overflow on mobile viewport (add overflow-x: hidden on body/html or inspect the trust marquee/footer wordmark for the leaking element).
No required fixes — all functional requirements pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Supabase anon key is embedded as a default in src/main.tsx (lines 22-31). Acceptable for a public anon role with RLS, but make sure the Supabase table 'prelaunch_waitlist_signups' has RLS policies that only allow INSERT (no SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE from anon).

WaitlistForm intentionally shares email/consent/waitlistState between hero and footer instances. Confirmed working but submitting in one form clears the input in the other and shows the success/error message under whichever form the user is currently looking at only via re-render — could surprise users who submit on hero then scroll down and see no confirmation under the footer form. Consider per-form local state.

main.tsx is a single 1196-line file. Per code-review guidelines, files >700 lines should be split — Header, Hero, Pillars, FAQ, Legal/Cookie modals, WaitlistForm, and the content arrays should each live in their own module.

No data-testid on nav-backdrop links individually, on the close button inside cookie-panel, and on the trainer 'Skriv dig op som træner' CTA already has data-testid='trainer-cta' (good). Consider adding for nav-backdrop links if mobile drawer needs deeper testing.
scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'}) on hero/venteliste is fine but on Safari iOS some versions ignore options object; consider polyfill or test on real iOS.
test_credentials: Not applicable — no auth on this site. Supabase anon key is embedded in client by design.
seed_data_creation: One real waitlist signup was created in Supabase prelaunch_waitlist_signups with email like 'qa+tm-redesign-test-<unix-timestamp>@example.com' (per instructions, happy-path submitted ONCE). Network response confirmed 201 Created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single-page Vite/React site at /app/src/main.tsx (no FastAPI backend). Preview URL: https://007f4f69-0fad-4e47-9ea0-585b9a133370.preview.emergentagent.com. Waitlist POSTs directly to public Supabase REST endpoint. Hero & footer waitlist forms share React state by design. All data-testids listed in the original request are present and working. Only minor cosmetic items remain (CSP meta frame-ancestors warning + 12px mobile horizontal overflow).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional bugs found. The CSP frame-ancestors console warning is a known browser limitation (the directive is HTTP-header-only and silently ignored from a <meta http-equiv> tag — not a bug in the app, just noisy logs). The Cloudflare beacon block is from the Emergent preview proxy injecting a script that the site's strict CSP correctly rejects — not affecting the page's own functionality.
